rule: Test local semantic laws independently of coordinates. A proved law may classify a family or reduce future geometry, but does not ratify D9 and does not assign a coordinate unless the law itself forces one.

proved_families.law: WITH-OPEN-FILE is observationally equivalent, on the abstract resource state and body result, to OPEN -> lexical body -> CLOSE. OPEN and CLOSE are opposite resource-state transitions but not mathematical inverses because handle allocation/history is observable.
positive_controls: scope begins with no live handle; body observes exactly one live handle; scope exits with no live handle
body result is preserved across automatic CLOSE
proved_families.falsifier: remove CLOSE: the live-handle set differs after scope exit
proved_families.host_boundary: abstract handle token only; no file descriptor, path implementation or OS API is semantic identity

proved_families.law: All three are instances of DEFINE-DESCRIPTOR(kind,name,payload); descriptor kind remains an observable independent axis: structure, type, condition.
positive_controls: same name may coexist under different descriptor kinds
lookup by (kind,name) recovers the corresponding payload
proved_families.falsifier: remove the kind axis: equal names overwrite/collapse observably distinct descriptor classes
proved_families.host_boundary: registry entries are abstract language descriptors, not host type metadata

proved_families.law: For shape [n], ROW-MAJOR-AREF(a,i)=AREF(a,i). For rank>1, the row-major linear index deterministically maps to a multidimensional index and therefore adds semantics not present in the one-dimensional D8 AREF identity.
positive_controls: rank-2 2x3 array: linear index 4 maps to multidimensional index [1,1]
proved_families.falsifier: treat linear index as only the first dimension index: rank-2 result differs or is out of range
proved_families.host_boundary: finite abstract array only; no host layout pointer or byte stride

proved_distinctions.law: NUNION is observably distinct from pure UNION when alias-visible mutation is admitted: an alias of the first input observes the destructive update; pure UNION leaves that alias unchanged.
proved_distinctions.positive_control: alias(first) changes after NUNION but not after UNION
proved_distinctions.falsifier: erase aliases: the destructive distinction becomes observationally invisible
proved_distinctions.prerequisite: D8 RPLACA/RPLACD already establish mutation observability
